import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 2

def design(feats):
    # Remove near-duplicates based on correlation
    corr_threshold = 0.6
    keep = []
    used = set()
    
    # Get correlation matrix
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x.T)
    
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if fid in used:
            continue
            
        # Find correlated features
        correlated = [j for j in range(len(feats.ids)) 
                     if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= corr_threshold and j != i]
        
        # Keep the one with highest effect size
        if correlated:
            # Check which has stronger effect (mean_y1 - mean_y0)
            effects = [abs(np.mean(feats.y[feats.x[:,j] > 0]) - np.mean(feats.y[feats.x[:,j] <= 0])) 
                      for j in correlated]
            best_corr = correlated[np.argmax(effects)]
            if best_corr < i:  # Only consider earlier indices to avoid duplicates
                continue
                
        keep.append(i)
        used.add(fid)
        
        # Mark correlated features as used
        for j in correlated:
            used.add(feats.ids[j])
    
    # Select top features by t-statistic
    selected_indices = sorted(keep, key=lambda i: abs(stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1,i], 
                                                                   feats.x[feats.y==0,i])[0]), 
                            reverse=True)[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    
    # Get driver features
    drivers = tuple(feats.ids[i] for i in selected_indices)
    
    # For columns, include only the drivers (keep model small)
    columns = drivers
    
    # For products, include interactions between drivers
    products = []
    for i in range(len(selected_indices)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(selected_indices)):
            products.append((feats.ids[selected_indices[i]], feats.ids[selected_indices[j]]))
    
    # Loadings - simple weights based on t-statistics
    loadings = {}
    for i, fid in enumerate(feats.ids):
        if i in selected_indices:
            t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1,i], feats.x[feats.y==0,i])[0]
            loadings[fid] = abs(t_stat)
    
    return Design(drivers=drivers, columns=columns, products=tuple(products), loadings=loadings)
